outfit.name: 神刀刀灵改良和服
outfit.prose: sacred blade spirit ceremonial attire: deep navy-black sleeveless modified kimono showing bare shoulders and armpits, layered white frilled undershirt, black and vermilion criss-cross chest cords with a center knot, yellow woven obi rope, tiered pleated skirt with lace hem, detached floating sleeves, and the sheathed Murasamemaru katana at her hip
